doc: A crop field to build (design/planner.md, Crops): its crop, its lot's size, how far it has grown, the season, and how many wind groups its plants share.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its lot: small (rect6x4), medium (rect8x6), or large (rect12x8).

fields.name: growth
fields.doc: How far it has grown: sown (furrows), sprouting, growing, ripe, or harvested (stubble).

fields.name: wind_groups
fields.doc: How many wind bones its plants share (1 to 16): the wind is computed this many times, however many plants.
